section.content: 本实用新型涉及锂离子电池领域，公开了一种锂离子电池，包括：电池本体模块，包括第一箱体以及电池本体，电池管理模块，包括第二箱体以及电池管理电路板，在第二箱体的顶部设置有第一接插件，上壳，安装于电池本体模块、电池本体模块的顶部，在上壳上安装有充放电均衡电路板、以及第二接插件，第二接插件与充放电均衡电路板电连接，位于第一接插件的上方，在第一箱体、第二箱体的相对的两垂直侧面的其中之一设置有滑槽，在另一设置有可沿滑槽向下滑出的棱，当第二箱体安装在第一箱体的垂直侧面时，棱限位在滑槽内，第一接插件、第二接插件相接插。采用该装配结构，提高了锂离子电池的组装便利性，拆卸灵活性。

The utility model relates to a lithium ion battery field discloses a lithium ion battery, include: the battery body module, including first box and battery body, the battery management module, including second box and battery management circuit board, top at the second box is provided with first connector, the epitheca, install in the battery body module, the top of battery body module, install the balanced circuit board of charge-discharge on the epitheca, and the second connector, the second connector is connected with the balanced circuit board electricity of charge-discharge, be located the top of first connector, at first box, one of the relative two perpendicular sides of second box is provided with the spout, be provided with the arris that can follow the spout and roll-off downwards at another, when the second box is installed at the perpendicular side of first box, the arris is spacing in the spout, first connector, the second connector connects mutually. By adopting the assembly structure, the assembly convenience and the disassembly flexibility of the lithium ion battery are improved.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a lithium ion battery makes the field, especially relates to a lithium ion battery.

Background

Along with the development of science and technology, the application of electronic product in daily life, amusement and recreation and agricultural plant protection is more and more popularized, and plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle just is one of them, can realize shooing, unmanned value protection to the plant through plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle to and spraying of pesticide, nutrient water etc.. The higher the requirements on the performance and maintenance of the lithium ion battery are determined by the application scene of the plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle. The demand and application of lithium ion battery products are increasing, and therefore, the requirements for production efficiency, after-sales service and recycling of the products are also increasing.

In the Battery products commonly used in the market at present, a Battery pack and a PCBA board of a Battery Management System (Battery Management System, commonly called BMS) are integrated, and in the prior art, in order to meet the waterproof requirement of the Battery products, a Battery module needs to be loaded into a box body, and then the box body is sealed by gluing.

The inventor of the present invention has found in the course of research of the present invention that the integration and gluing structure of the prior art has the following defects, the production and assembly of the battery product are inconvenient, and the internal battery module is easily damaged when the box body is disassembled for BMS maintenance during the later maintenance, and the disassembly of the box body is very difficult, and the material recycling rate is not high.

Disclosure of Invention

An object of the embodiment of the utility model is to provide a lithium ion battery adopts this assembly structure, more is favorable to improving lithium ion battery's equipment convenience, and the flexibility is dismantled in the maintenance.

In a first aspect, an embodiment of the present invention provides a lithium ion battery, including:

the battery body module comprises a first box body and a battery body packaged in the first box body, wherein the battery body is composed of a plurality of battery cores which are connected in series or in parallel or the combination of the battery cores and the battery body,

the battery management module comprises a second box body and a battery management circuit board packaged in the second box body, a first connector is arranged at the top of the second box body and is electrically connected with the battery management circuit board,

an upper case installed on the top of the battery body module, a charge and discharge balance circuit board and a second connector installed on the upper case, the second connector electrically connected with the charge and discharge balance circuit board and located above the first connector,

one of two opposite vertical side surfaces of the first box body and the second box body is provided with a sliding groove, the other vertical side surface of the first box body and the second box body is provided with an edge which can slide out downwards along the sliding groove, when the second box body is arranged on the vertical side surface of the first box body, the edge is limited in the sliding groove, and the first connector and the second connector are connected in an inserting mode.

Optionally, at least two parallel first ribs are arranged on one of the opposite vertical side surfaces of the first box body and the second box body, each first rib has a predetermined interval with the vertical side surface, each first sliding groove is arranged between each first rib and the vertical side surface,

at least two parallel second ribs are arranged on the other of the opposite vertical side surfaces of the first box body and the second box body, and second sliding grooves are formed on the inner sides of the second ribs;

when the second box body is arranged on the vertical side face of the first box body, each first ridge is limited in each second sliding groove which is opposite to the first ridge, each second ridge is limited in each first sliding groove which is opposite to the second ridge, and when the first connector and the second connector are separated, the second box body can slide downwards along the first sliding grooves and the second sliding grooves.

Optionally, the first case includes: a first cylindrical middle frame and a first bottom cover which is packaged at the bottom opening of the first middle frame,

the second case includes: a second cylindrical middle frame and a second bottom cover which is packaged at the bottom opening of the second middle frame,

the first sliding groove, the first rib, the second sliding groove and the second rib are respectively arranged on opposite vertical side faces of the first middle frame and the second middle frame.

Optionally, a waterproof sealing ring is arranged between the bottom end of the side wall of the first middle frame and the first bottom cover and/or between the bottom end of the side wall of the second middle frame and the second bottom cover at intervals, and the waterproof sealing ring located therein is in a compressed state.

Optionally, an annular groove is further formed in the position, opposite to the side walls of the first middle frame and the second middle frame, of the first bottom cover and/or the second bottom cover, and the waterproof sealing ring is limited in the groove.

Optionally, reinforcing ribs are further disposed on the side walls and the bottom of the first bottom cover and/or the second bottom cover.

Optionally, a waterproof sealing ring is further spaced between the upper shell and the connecting position of the side walls of the first middle frame and the second middle frame, and the waterproof sealing ring located in the waterproof sealing ring is in a compressed state.

Optionally, a handle is further arranged on the top of the upper shell.

Optionally, an electric quantity display device electrically connected with the battery management circuit board is further disposed on an outward vertical side surface of the second middle frame.

Optionally, a communication interface electrically connected to the charge and discharge equalization circuit board is further disposed on the upper case.

Therefore, the technical scheme of the embodiment has the following beneficial effects:

first, the battery management module and the battery body module of the embodiment are independent modules, and the battery management module can be detached independently without opening the connection between the upper case and the battery body module, so that the battery management module can be maintained or replaced, and self-power consumption of the battery management module in a non-use state is avoided.

In addition, the battery management module and the battery body module of the embodiment are in sliding connection with the vertical side, and the battery management module and the upper shell are fixedly connected through the plugging of the first connector and the second plugging piece, so that the circuit connection and the structure fixed connection of the battery body module and the battery management module are realized, and the battery management module is firmly fixed on the vertical side of the battery body module at the bottom of the upper shell. The matching of the sliding groove between the vertical side surfaces of the battery management module and the battery body module and the edge capable of sliding along the sliding groove also ensures the position right alignment between the two plugging pieces, improves the convenience of plugging and unplugging, and is convenient for users to assemble.

The matched connection of the sliding groove and the edge is adopted, the plugging and unplugging directions of the first connector and the second plugging and unplugging piece are ensured, and the damage of the plugging and unplugging piece caused by the deviation of the plugging and unplugging directions is avoided.

In conclusion, compared with the prior art, the modularized independent assembly structure is favorable for assembly and maintenance of the lithium ion battery, and the lithium ion battery can be taken down to be disconnected from the battery management module in non-use states such as transportation or storage, so that the electric loss caused by discharging of the battery body is avoided.

Detailed Description

The invention will be described in detail with reference to the drawings and specific embodiments, wherein the exemplary embodiments and descriptions are provided to explain the invention, but not to limit the invention.

Example 1

See fig. 1-11.

The present embodiment provides a lithium ion battery, which mainly includes: battery body 12, module 1, battery management module 2, and upper case 3. The battery body 12 module 1 and the battery management module 2 are two independent modules which are not mutually influenced in disassembly, the battery body 12 module 1 and the battery management module 2 are assembled in parallel, and the upper shell 3 is arranged on the tops of the two modules and is connected with the two modules into a whole.

The battery body 12 module 1 includes a case (referred to as a first case 11) and a battery body 12 enclosed in the first case 11. The battery body 12 is a battery pack formed by a plurality of battery cells connected in series or in parallel or a combination of series and parallel, specifically, electrodes of the battery cells are respectively welded on the series-parallel plates 10 preset with a series-parallel circuit in a penetrating manner to realize electrical connection of the battery cells.

The battery management module 2 includes another case (referred to as a second case 21) and a battery management circuit board 20 (not shown) enclosed in the second case 21. The battery management circuit board 20 includes a PCB substrate, copper foil traces of a battery management circuit disposed in the PCB substrate, and electronic components and chips soldered on the surface of the PCB substrate, wherein a battery management system program is preset on the chips. A connector (denoted as a first connector 22) is electrically connected to the battery management circuit board 20, and the first connector 22 is disposed on the charge/discharge equalization circuit board or electrically connected to the charge/discharge equalization circuit board through a wire. The battery management circuit is electrically connected with the charge and discharge equalization circuit through the plugging of the first connector 22 and the second connector 42, and the battery management circuit performs equalization management on the charge and discharge of each battery cell in the battery body 12 through the charge and discharge equalization circuit.

A sliding groove is arranged on the vertical side surface of the first box body 11 (and/or the second box body 21), and a ridge which can be limited in the sliding groove and can slide in the sliding groove is arranged on the vertical side surface of the second box body 21 (and/or the first box body 11). When the second casing 21 is mounted to the vertical side of the first casing 11, the second casing 21 is pushed along the slide groove to a predetermined position on the side of the first casing 11 by matching the rib and the slide groove on the vertical side of the first casing 11 and the second casing 21, the two casings are arranged side by side, and the second casing 21 is limited to the vertical side of the first casing 11 by matching the rib and the slide groove.

A charge/discharge equalization circuit board (not shown) is provided on the upper case 3, and a connector (denoted as a second connector 42) electrically connected to the charge/discharge equalization circuit is provided on the charge/discharge equalization circuit board. The tabs of each battery cell of the battery body 12 of the battery management module 2 extend out from the top and are respectively welded on the charging and discharging equalization circuit board which is opposite to the tab, each battery cell forms a battery pack through the serial connection or the parallel connection of the charging and discharging equalization circuits or the combination of the serial connection and the parallel connection, and the charging and discharging equalization circuits perform equalization control on the charging and discharging of each battery cell under the control of the battery management module 2.

The second connector 42 and the first connector 22 are opposite in position and can be mutually inserted and plugged, and can be pulled out and disconnected, when the second connector 42 and the first connector 22 are connected and plugged, the battery management module 2 is fixed on the lower shell and is fixed with the battery body 12 module 1 into a whole, the battery management module 2 is electrically connected with a charge and discharge balancing circuit of the battery body 12 module 1, the battery body 12 supplies power to the battery management module 2 through the charge and discharge balancing circuit, and the battery management module 2 works to perform balancing control management on the charge and discharge of each battery cell of the battery body 12 through the charge and discharge balancing circuit.

As an illustration of the present embodiment, the first connector 22 and the second connector 42 of the present embodiment can be various connectors in the prior art, such as but not limited to various electrical plugs and electrical sockets in the prior art, and are not described herein again.

When sliding battery management module 2 downwards along the vertical side of first box 11, can make second connector 42, first connector 22 throw off, battery management module 2 is thrown off from the bottom of epitheca 3, the electricity between disconnection battery management module 2 and battery body 12 module 1 is connected, battery body 12 module 1 stops external discharge, further promote battery management module 2 to slide downwards to the roll-off along the vertical side of battery body 12 module 1, take off battery management module 2 from the vertical side of battery body 12 module 1, become independent module, the user can dismantle the maintenance and change another battery management module 2 for battery body 12 module 1.

Therefore, the technical scheme of the embodiment has the following beneficial effects:

first, the battery management module 2 and the battery body 12 module 1 of the present embodiment are independent modules, and the battery management module 2 can be detached alone without opening the connection between the upper case 3 and the battery body 12 module 1, so as to maintain or replace the battery management module 2, thereby avoiding damage to the battery body 12 module 1 when the battery management module 2 is maintained.

In addition, the battery management module 2 and the battery body 12 module 1 of the present embodiment are connected in a sliding manner by vertical side surfaces, and the battery management module 2 and the upper case 3 are fixedly connected by the insertion of the first connector 22 and the second connector 42, so that not only the circuit connection but also the structural fixed connection between the battery body 12 module 1 and the battery management module 2 are realized, and the battery management module 2 is firmly fixed on the vertical side surface of the battery body 12 module 1 at the bottom of the upper case 3. The matching of the sliding groove between the vertical side surfaces of the battery management module 2 and the battery body 12 and the edge capable of sliding along the sliding groove also ensures the position alignment between the two plugging pieces, improves the convenience of plugging and unplugging, and is convenient for users to assemble.

The matching connection of the sliding groove and the ridge ensures the plugging and unplugging directions of the first connector 22 and the second connector 42, and avoids the damage of the plugging and unplugging pieces caused by the deviation of the plugging and unplugging directions.

In summary, compared with the prior art, the modularized independent assembly structure of the embodiment is beneficial to the assembly and maintenance of the lithium ion battery, and when the lithium ion battery is in non-use states such as transportation or storage, the battery management module 2 can be taken down to be disconnected from the electric connection with the battery body 12 and the module 1, so that the electric loss caused by the discharge of the battery body 12 is avoided.

As an illustration of the present embodiment, the connection between the first box 11 and the second box 21 of the present embodiment may adopt, but is not limited to, the following technical solutions:

at least one vertically extending rib (denoted as a first rib 14) which is apart from the first vertical side 13 and located at the front end of the first vertical side 13 and has a predetermined gap with the first vertical side 13 extends outside the vertical side (denoted as the first vertical side 13) of the first box 11 facing the second box 21, but not limited to, two first ribs 14 which are parallel to each other are oppositely arranged on the first vertical side 13 in the front-back direction, so that the second box 21 is limited from the front side and the back side of the box, the assembling and the positioning of the second box 21 are facilitated, and the assembling convenience is improved. A sliding groove (denoted as a first sliding groove 15) extending in the vertical direction is formed between each first rib 14 and the first vertical side surface 13, at least the lower end of the sliding groove is open so that a second rib 24 positioned in the sliding groove can freely slide out, and two sliding grooves are formed between the two first ribs 14 and the first vertical side surface 13.

Correspondingly, on the second vertical side 23 of the second box 21, wherein the second vertical side 23 faces the first vertical side 13 of the first box 11, at least one rib (second rib 24) is provided on the second vertical side 23, which is parallel to and faces the first sliding grooves 15 on the first box 11, and a sliding groove (denoted as second sliding groove 25) is provided on the inner side of each second rib 24. The number of the second ribs 24 is the same as the number of the first sliding grooves 15 on the first box body 11, the positions are opposite, and the directions are the same, so that each second rib 24 on the second box body 21 is limited on the first sliding groove 15 opposite to the second rib and behind the first rib 14 on the side of the first sliding groove 15; the number of the second sliding grooves 25 is the same as the number of the first ribs 14 on the first box body 11, so that each first rib 14 on the first box body 11 is limited in the second sliding groove 25 which is opposite to the first rib, and is limited behind the second rib 24 on the side of the second sliding groove 25. When the battery management module 2 is assembled, the second ribs 24 of the second case 21 may correspond to the first sliding grooves 15 of the first case 11 from top to bottom (if the upper case 3 is not installed yet), or the second sliding grooves 25 may correspond to the first ribs 14 of the first case 11 from bottom to top, and the second case 21 is pushed along the sliding grooves to slide along the first case 11 from bottom to top until the first connector 22 installed on the top of the battery management module 2 is inserted into the second connector 42 of the upper case 3, so that the battery management module 2 is accurately assembled to the battery body 12 module 1 side, and the electrical connection with the battery body 12 module 1 is completed. The design of the sliding grooves on the opposite vertical side surfaces of the first box body 11 and the second box body 21 and the edges limited in the sliding grooves limits the horizontal direction of the second box body 21, the connection and the insertion of the connectors at the top of the second box body accurately align the vertical position of the second box body 21, and the assembly and the fixation of the battery management module 2 are realized.

When the battery management module 2 needs to be detached, the battery management module 2 is pulled downwards to be disengaged from the first connector 22 of the upper shell 3, and the battery management module 2 continues to slide downwards along the first sliding groove 15 of the first box body 11 until the battery management module slides downwards out of the lower end opening of the first sliding groove 15, so that the independent detachment of the battery management module 2 is completed.

As an illustration of the present embodiment, but not limited to, the design of first sliding groove 15 and first rib 14 on the first side surface of first case 11 may be exchanged with the design of second sliding groove 25 and second rib 24 on second vertical side surface 23 of second case 21.

As an illustration of the present embodiment, but not limited to, the first casing 11 may be designed as a split structure, and the first casing 11 includes: a first middle frame 16 which is a cylindrical shape with upper and lower openings and is used as a vertical side wall of the box body, and a first bottom cover 17 which is assembled at the bottom of the first middle frame 16 and is sealed at the opening of the bottom of the first middle frame, wherein each first sliding groove 15 and each first ridge 14 matched with the battery management module 2 are arranged on one vertical side surface of the first middle frame 16. When the battery body 12 and the module 1 are assembled, the battery body 12 is arranged on the first bottom cover 17, then the cylindrical first middle frame 16 is sleeved outside the battery body 12 from top to bottom, the bottom of the vertical side wall of the first middle frame 16 is connected with the first bottom cover 17, the first middle frame 16 is fixedly connected with the first bottom cover 17 through screws, and the split structure is adopted, so that the convenience in assembling, maintaining and disassembling the battery body 12 is facilitated.

In addition, but not limited to, the first waterproof gasket 41 may be further spaced at a connection position of the first middle frame 16 and the first bottom case, and when the connection is performed, the fastening screw is tightened to compress the first waterproof gasket 41, so as to seal the connection between the first middle frame 16 and the first bottom case, thereby improving the moisture resistance of the first box 11.

As an illustration of the present embodiment, the second casing 21 may be designed to have a split structure in the same manner, and the second casing 21 includes: a second middle frame 26 of a cylindrical shape with an upper and lower opening, and a second bottom cover 27 assembled to the bottom of the second middle frame 26 and sealed at the opening of the bottom thereof, wherein each second sliding groove 25 and each second rib 24 matched with the battery body 12 and the module 1 are provided on one vertical side surface of the second middle frame 26.

When the battery management module 2 is assembled, the battery management circuit board 20 is inserted into the second middle frame 26 and is screwed into the second middle frame 26, and the cylindrical design with the two ends open is adopted, so that the installation and observation of the battery management circuit board 20 are facilitated. And then the bottom of the first middle frame 16 and the first bottom cover 17 are fixedly connected together by using screws.

Similarly, the second waterproof sealing ring 42 may be further spaced at the connection position between the second middle frame 26 and the second bottom case, and when the connection is performed, the fastening screw is screwed to compress the second waterproof sealing ring 42, so as to seal the connection between the second middle frame 26 and the second bottom case, thereby improving the moisture resistance of the second box 21.

As an illustration of the present embodiment, but not limited to, the grooves 5 are disposed at positions of the first bottom cover 17 and the second bottom cover 27 facing the side walls of the cylindrical first middle frame 16 and the cylindrical second middle frame 26, and the first waterproof sealing ring 41 and the second waterproof sealing ring 42 are respectively disposed in each groove 5 to limit the positions of the waterproof sealing rings, so as to avoid displacement during screw fastening from affecting the waterproof performance.

As an illustration of the present embodiment, but not limited to, the screw fastening positions of the first middle frame 16 and the first bottom cover 17 and the screw fastening positions of the second middle frame 26 and the second bottom cover 27 may be respectively set at the corner positions to meet the requirements of the width and the strength of the screw penetrating position. Preferably, but not limited to, a hole portion is provided at a corner position of each waterproof sealing ring for a fastening screw to pass through, so as to position and fix the waterproof sealing ring.

As an example of the present embodiment, a third waterproof seal 43 may be provided at the bottom of the upper casing 3, and the third waterproof seal 43 is spaced between the upper casing 3 and the top end surface of the first cylindrical middle frame 16, and between the upper casing 3 and the top end surface of the second cylindrical middle frame 26. The top end face of the upper shell 3 and the first middle frame 16 is connected through screws at corners in a fastening mode, the third waterproof sealing ring 43 is in a compression mode during fastening, and the moisture-proof performance between the square shell and the battery body 12 module 1 is improved.

As an illustration of the present embodiment, a plurality of reinforcing ribs 6 having a thickness thicker than that of the side walls may be provided on the inner sides of the side walls of the first and second bottom covers 17 and 27, and the reinforcing ribs 6 may be integrated with the side walls in the vertical direction, thereby improving the strength of the first and second bottom covers 17 and 27.

In addition, but not limited to, the height of the reinforcing rib 6 is higher than that of the first bottom cover 17 and the second bottom cover 27 to limit the first waterproof sealing ring 41 and the second waterproof sealing ring 42 in the groove 5, so that the waterproof sealing rings are prevented from being inwardly displaced to influence the waterproof performance when the screws are fastened.

As an illustration of the present embodiment, a handle 7 is further disposed on the top of the upper case 3 to facilitate portability of the lithium ion battery.

As an illustration of the present embodiment, a power indicator light 8 is further disposed on the vertical side surface of the outward outer side of the second middle frame 26, and the power indicator light 8 is electrically connected to the battery management circuit board 20 to indicate the current actual power of the battery body 12.

As an illustration of the present embodiment, a status indicator light 10 of the battery body module is further disposed on the vertical side surface of the outward outer side of the second middle frame 26 to indicate the current status of the battery body module 1, such as normal operation, fault status, etc., specifically set according to the user's needs. And an electricity shortage alarm device can be set to remind a user of charging in time.

As an illustration of the present embodiment, a communication interface 9 is further provided on the upper case 3 to facilitate transmission of the battery management data to an external device.

As an illustration of the present embodiment, the bottom and the side of the battery pack body 12 are respectively covered with foam 18 to provide buffer protection for the battery pack body 12.

As an illustration of the present embodiment, an insulating bead 19 is further disposed on the top of the battery body 12 to press the battery body 12 against the first case 1.

The above-described embodiments do not limit the scope of the present invention. Any modification, equivalent replacement, and improvement made within the spirit and principle of the above-described embodiments should be included in the protection scope of the technical solution.
